source.legacyPattern: per-item Barter/Trade ladders for rigs, pockets and backpacks

proofAuthority.equipmentBoundary: explicit validated item TPL sets only; IncludeNotEquippedItems=false; no category/class inference
proofAuthority.extractionBoundary: successful extraction shape is proven, but same-raid equipment/action coupling remains separately fail-closed

description.en: A loadout is not a catalogue. Build one practical expedition kit, carry it through contact, and return with the capability intact. I am evaluating deployment discipline, not how many rigs and backpacks you can hand over.
description.ru: Выкладка — не каталог. Собери один практичный экспедиционный комплект, проведи его через контакт и вернись, сохранив боеспособность. Я оцениваю дисциплину развёртывания, а не количество разгрузок и рюкзаков, которые ты можешь сдать.

started.en: Deploy wearing the approved light field rig and backpack, then extract successfully. Keep your equipment. The test is whether a simple expedition setup supports the raid, not whether you can surrender a pile of gear.
started.ru: Выйди в рейд в утверждённой лёгкой разгрузке и с рюкзаком, затем успешно эвакуируйся. Снаряжение остаётся у тебя. Проверяется, работает ли простая экспедиционная выкладка в рейде, а не способность сдать гору вещей.

success.en: The equipment supported the operation instead of becoming the objective. That is the point of a field loadout.
success.ru: Снаряжение поддержало операцию, а не стало её целью. В этом и смысл полевой выкладки.

objectiveIntent: wear one exact low-tier chest rig and one exact low-tier backpack without handover
survive or extract once with the selected expedition pair
replace 150 per-item legacy tasks with one coherent capability check

selectedEquipment.selectionDoctrine: Use ordinary low-tier field gear that proves preparation without forcing expensive armor, rare equipment, a trader-specific purchase, or an item handover.

requiredPair.name: Scav Vest
requiredPair.rationale: Unarmored, low-tier chest rig; the objective tests carrying capacity and preparation rather than armor class or purchasing power.

requiredPair.name: Scav backpack
requiredPair.rationale: Ordinary low-tier backpack with enough field utility to represent expedition preparation without turning the objective into a premium-gear tax.

reward.rationale: The selected gear is not surrendered or consumed and no item/storefront reward is granted. The existing early-campaign standard reward therefore needs no acquisition-cost reimbursement or gear-faucet escalation.

permanentDifferentiators: exact Scav Vest plus exact Scav backpack pair
